messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Key Points (2024)** | Topic | Summary | |-------|---------| | **Speed Limits** | • General speed limit on highways: 55–75 mph (varies by county).
• Rural interstate: 70 mph.
• Urban interstate: 65 mph.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 35 mph if posted). | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child‑safety seat.
• Children 8–15 must use a booster seat. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is illegal.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08 % or higher is illegal.
• For commercial drivers: 0.04 %.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has the right of way.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks. | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red light: stop.
• Yellow light: prepare to stop.
• Green light: proceed (unless a sign indicates otherwise). | | **Lane Discipline** | • Keep to the right lane unless passing.
• Use turn signals at least 100 ft before turning. | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk or intersection.
• No parking on a curb unless a sign permits it. | | **School Bus** | • Stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• Vehicles must stop on both sides of the road. | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Vehicles must be towed if they pose a hazard or are abandoned. | | **Vehicle Registration & Insurance** | • Must display valid registration and proof of insurance. | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles: helmet required for riders under 18.
• Commercial vehicles: must follow specific weight and safety regulations. | **Where to Find More Details** - Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – [https://www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) - Texas Transportation Code (Title 7) – available online via the Texas Legislature website. - Texas Department of Public Safety – Driver’s Handbook. Feel free to ask if you need deeper details on any specific law or regulation!
